description: This is a Perl script (kconfig.pl) used for managing and manipulating kernel configuration options, including loading, comparing, and updating configuration settings based on a specific syntax.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sets the configuration value for a given key based on specified conditions.

methods.name: load_config
methods.description: Loads configuration settings from a specified file into a hash reference.

methods.name: config_and
methods.description: Performs an AND operation on two configuration hashes.

methods.name: config_add
methods.description: Combines two configuration hashes with optional modifications.

methods.name: config_diff
methods.description: Returns differences between two configuration hashes.

methods.name: config_sub
methods.description: Subtracts one configuration hash from another.

methods.name: print_cfgline
methods.description: Prints a configuration line based on key and value.

methods.name: dump_config
methods.description: Outputs the entire configuration in a readable format.

methods.name: parse_expr
methods.description: Parses configuration expressions and returns the resulting configuration hash.
